limitations: Transform components are scene statistics, not physical quantities — components are not comparable across scenes without the fitted coefficients
Radiometric domain must be consistent across every input band before fitting
Component sign/order is dataset-dependent; never hardcode band meaning
Noise covariance estimate dominates MNF quality; low-SNR scenes produce noise components
Requires band wavelengths metadata; results are relative (normalized absorption depth)
Amplifies band noise; prefer smoothed or resampled spectra
Sensor response functions must match the source product; FWHM-based resampling is approximate
Endmember count must not exceed band count; fractions are non-negative and sum to one only for constrained variants
Extracted endmembers are scene-local spectra, not library signatures
Target signature must be in the same radiometric domain as the scene
RX flags statistical outliers, not materials — every anomaly needs visual or spectral confirmation
Detector response is threshold-dependent; report the threshold alongside the mask
ACE cosine similarity assumes the target signature shares the scene radiometric domain
